text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The central bank sees its most important goal in maintaining the stability of the currency, Jozef Makuch, the central bank's currency institute director said.
Slovakia is one of few states where only one institution, the NBS, oversees both the monetary policy and the bank supervision, he said.
- Not all candidates for European Union membership will be accepted at the same time, an EU official said. The EU is currently preparing its official statement to each application for membership.

PRAVDA - Some 30,000 students from 26 faculties are on strike alert. The strike leaders demand public discussion of problems in the education sector with government officials, otherwise they will intensify their protest actions.

- Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar's ruling Movement for a Democratic Slovakia demands that Czech President Vaclav Havel publicly apologise for recent remarks on Meciar in an interview with the French paper Le Figaro.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Japanese electronics producer Matsushita Electric Industrial Co. Ltd plans to open a branch in Slovakia this year which would employ some 800 workers.

SME - Slovakia is internationally isolated due to its domestic policy, former prime minister and opposition leader Jan Carnogursky said. A few foreign trips by Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar cannot break the isolation and bad international position of Slovakia compared to neighbouring countries.
- Unknown persons destroyed or damaged 165 tombstones in a Jewish cemetary in Nove Zamky, southern Slovakia.
